notes.title: Major VR update to UI and controllers
notes.notes:
VR Space dudes.
We’ve just pushed a big update and completely replaced the VR UI. The new UI can now be controlled with your weak hand so you can use your strong hand to control your personal joystick.
Additionally, we’ve improved the speech bubbles and cameras in the VR stories.
To see this update please right-click SpaceSEX in your steam.exe and go to settings >> betas and select the beta-vr branch.
Hope you enjoy the new update and please let us know if you see any bugs or other issues.
Have a wonderful weekend.
SpaceSEX
